title: "Wanna Go to Lisbon?"
old_caption:
Planning a trip before you've even said hi?
Ask about their best trip first. The rest can wait.

title: 12 Signs, 12 Openers
old_caption:
Twelve signs send a first message. Which one is yours?
The best opener sounds like you, plus one real question.

title: Aries Has 60 Seconds
old_caption:
Could you write the perfect opener in 60 seconds?
Funny, true and a question is all it takes. Wait for the reply.

title: San Francisco: The Fog Ate the Plan
old_caption:
Virgo laminated a six-stop night. The fog had other plans.
The best part of the night was the stop nobody planned. Who in your group makes the itinerary?

title: Portland: The Friend Who Always Cancels
old_caption:
Cancer typed "rain check?" for the fourth time. The friends were already at the door.
Tag the friend who needs an umbrella for three.

title: Washington, DC: The Fifth Seat
old_caption:
Two couples, one booth, and Capricorn holding the map.
Turns out the fifth seat planned the best night of everyone's year. Who's the fifth seat in your friend group?

title: Mexico City: My Ex Is at Every Stop
old_caption:
Tacos, mariachis, the big square: the ex was at every single one.
Scorpio ran out of places to hide and just said hi. Then churros. Would you hide or wave?

title: Tokyo: First Date vs the Last Train
old_caption:
First date, one hour until the last train, and they would not stop talking.
Cold noodles, one off-key song, zero regrets. Would you run for the train?

title: Paris: Solo in the City of Couples
old_caption:
Aries took themself to Paris. Every bench had a couple on it.
Two croissants, one portrait and a window table later, the solo trip won. Ever taken yourself out?

title: London: Are You Two Together?
old_caption:
Three months of just hanging out. Everyone in London asked the question except them.
The answer was waiting on the night bus. Who should ask first?
